chunks: And it was narrated: “He discontinues the talbiyah when he sees the houses of Makkah.”

key_terms.التَّلْبِيَةَ: the talbiyah, the ritual invocation recited in ihram
key_terms.رُوِيَ: it was narrated; indicates a transmitted report

ai.seo_question: When should the talbiyah be stopped during ʿumrah?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling regarding the point at which the performer of ʿumrah stops reciting the talbiyah. It indicates that the talbiyah is discontinued upon seeing the houses of Makkah, marking a recognized ritual transition in the rites.
